sourceExample: In a crisis, try to keep your head.
sourceMeaning: Stay calm and sensible; a fixed bodily idiom.
canonicalMeaning: Remain calm and able to think clearly in a difficult or tense situation.
comparison: Both forms ask a person to remain calm and think clearly in a crisis. The drafted seven-step decisions and canonical 491 teach the same boundary; a lexical surface variant does not warrant a second owner.
